test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: In February 2026, Rohit Rishi assumed charge as the Managing Director of India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd (IIFCL). What percentage stake is held by the Government of India in IIFCL?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100 percent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Rohit Rishi has assumed charge as the Managing Director of India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd (IIFCL) in February 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **IIFCL is a wholly-owned company of the Government of India, implying 100 percent government ownership.**
 
• IIFCL was established in 2006 to provide long-term financial assistance to viable infrastructure projects.
 
• Rohit Rishi brings over three decades of experience in the banking and financial services sector.
 
• Before joining IIFCL, he served as Executive Director at the Bank of Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd (IIFCL)__

 __
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Ownership – 100 percent Government of India
 
• Provides long-term finance for infrastructure projects
 
 
 
• SIFTI Scheme__
 
 
• Stands for Scheme for Financing Viable Infrastructure Projects
 
• Implemented through a Special Purpose Vehicle in the form of IIFCL
 
• Aims to support large infrastructure projects with long-term funding
